_comment: Non-operative record for the historical ManyForge Hermes gateway preset.
There is deliberately no 'manyforge' preset while the MCP and assistant clients are unavailable.
A consumer requesting PRESETS_B64=['manyforge'] must fail instead of receiving a stale bridge or fixed Composer endpoint.

required_behavior: inject only a qualified public MCP client
resolve owner-issued endpoints instead of a fixed Composer address
preserve proxy interpolation without embedding secrets
capture bounded first-boot catalog and audit evidence
